# WebSim

> An AI-powered creative platform for building and sharing interactive games, web pages, and educational content without traditional coding barriers.

WebSim enables users to create interactive experiences through AI-assisted development, supporting everything from educational games to gaming mods and animations. The platform combines creative tools with community features, making it accessible for beginners while supporting advanced creative projects.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered app development
- Interactive playground
- Creative coding
- User-generated content
- Educational games
- Gaming mods
- Vibe coding
- Animation effects
- Beginner-friendly projects
- Community creations
- React integration

- Game development
- Web development

## Platform Overview

- [Websim](https://websim.com): Create and share interactive games, web pages, and creative content with AI-powered development tools
